notes.content:

notes.title: ABC Paint available to everyone + New Features
notes.content:
[u][b]ABC Paint is now available for everyone[/b][/u] to play with their friends! We've also improved the user overall experience and added some new features.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33431260/39f9d5fdf27e3a87d65e1c640322ecd4b375ece6.png[/img]

[b]This update brings you the following changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Painting on other player's heads
[*] Teleportation in a small area (touch pad)
[*] MixCast support
[*] Undo can now rollback the "delete all" command
[*] UX improvements for palette interaction (better feedback)
[/list]

With these updates we tried to add more value to the game and improve the overall user experience. 

Allowing players to draw all kinds of shapes and objects on their friend's heads is a fun way to spend time in ABC Paint and provides a more connected experience for everyone involved.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33431260/4510f103638d3cf92fbb536d06b83bcfe117de9b.gif[/img]

The teleportation functionality should give more breathing space for players in a multiplayer experience. It also allows players to create bigger drawings and view them at a distance. While it does add additional complexity to user interaction, it should still be simple enough to be usable by everyone.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33431260/d0aa4217ae5754fbf6730fd118e3773af7fae8ed.gif[/img]

We find your feedback to be very valuable to us and yourselves, so let us know of any problems you encounter or ideas and suggestions you have.
You can contact us at kristen@futuruum.ee.

notes.title: ABC Paint Multiplayer Update!
notes.content:
Huge multiplayer update time!

What is more fun than simple painting in VR? Simple painting in VR with friends, of course! 

[b]With the latest and greatest update we have done the following:[/b]
[list]
[*] Re-written backend (now running on Unity)
[*] Multiplayer support with VOIP (up to 4 people in a single room)
[*] Different environments (empty scene, christmas theme, car, stage, people)
[*] Randomized heads for the players 
[/list]

[b]Still in the works:[/b]
[list]
[*] Attaching paint strokes to player head
[*] More environments to come
[*] MixCast support
[/list]

With this huge update we still tried to keep everything as simple and "kid-friendly" as possible: the new menu features only a few large colour coded buttons that are always at the player height and should make it easy to start solo and multiplayer sessions by simply touching the spheres. The server list only shows games created by Steam friends.

[b]Don't like the update? [/b]No problem! The original version of the game is available under the "singleplayer" beta branch from Steam (right click on the game > properties >  betas).

Please send all your thoughts, feedback and potential problems to Madis@futuruum.ee - as we are developing this app solely for VR arcade use, we would love to get feedback and act fast on it.
